note: Perry County IL (17145) parcels are published only through the county's Schneider Beacon viewer (proprietary, returns HTTP 403 bot challenge; no public ArcGIS REST service found). Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no Perry County IL parcel FeatureServer. The semogis PerryCo/PerryAssess service is Perry County, Missouri, and the Perry County PA Experience map is Pennsylvania. Parcel polygons are only available from commercial vendors (Equator, Rockford Map Publishers) under license fees.
